name: California

measures.name: Proposition
measures.note: Measures can be citizen initiatives or referred by the Legislature. Constitutional amendments need a statewide vote to change later.

constitutionalNote: This amends the state constitution, so changing it later takes another statewide vote.

retention.note: Appellate justices face yes/no retention votes; a majority Yes keeps them.

primarySystem: Top-two: the two candidates with the most primary votes advance, regardless of party.
endorserNote: Party and League positions come from search summaries of their published lists; CA GOP positions were read from a summary, so confirm on their site.

questions.q: Judges on retention ballots run unopposed and can't campaign. When no problem with a judge has been found, what's your default?
